perGuessRating: travle-game-state.guessRatings[i] (emoji), parallel to pastGuessIds[i]; also shown in the past-guesses list and share text. Emoji set from game JS: ✅ perfect (on shortest path and connected), 🟩 near-perfect (on a shortest path but not yet connected), 🟧 good (detour of at most 1 extra country), 🟥 poor (bigger detour). The list button title attribute carries the English meaning.
mapFill: Computed CSS fill of svg.map_display path#<ISO3>1 by class. This is NOT the rating: it encodes connection to the start country.

mapClassColours.country-connected: rgb(221, 199, 161) #ddc7a1 (guess linked to the start by a chain of guesses)
mapClassColours.country-disconnected: rgb(80, 74, 69) #504a45 (guess not linked to start; the help text calls these gray)
mapClassColours.country-outline: fill rgb(80, 74, 69), stroke rgb(80, 74, 69) (hint-revealed outline, not a guess)
